The Ce(FeO₃)₂ structure crystallizes in the trigonal space group P-3 (No. 143), with a unit cell containing 15 atoms—1 Ce, 2 Fe, and 12 O—distributed across 4 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies Fe centers as octahedral with six O neighbors (2.04–2.12 Å), while Ce centers show a close-packed-like arrangement of 12 O neighbors (2.37–2.47 Å). Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and face-sharing between Fe octahedra and corner-sharing between Ce and Fe polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 15 sites.
